name: Deqing Shanyinju Country House
aiSummary: Review summary Powered by AI Location and Accessibility:The property is conveniently located near the Mogan Mountain shuttle bus stop, accessible by walking. It is also noted for its proximity to local restaurants and shops, making it easy for guests to explore the area without needing to travel far.(based on 2 reviews)

topics.text: The property is conveniently located near the Mogan Mountain shuttle bus stop, accessible by walking. It is also noted for its proximity to local restaurants and shops, making it easy for guests to explore the area without needing to travel far.

address: No. 22, Xia Village, Houwu Village, Fatao Township, Deqing, Zhejiang, 313202, China

comments.quote: 一共三家一起出遊，可以放心孩子們在院子裏玩耍，晚飯後，輔導孩子們學習，出去遊玩還不耽誤學習，附近也有很多飯店，民宿裏可以自製咖啡和茶飲，不錯，民宿離莫干山的擺渡車上車點很近，步行過去都可以。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: Three families travelling together, and you can let the children play in the courtyard without worrying. After dinner we sat with them over their schoolwork, so the trip did not cost them any study time. There are plenty of restaurants nearby, and you can make your own coffee and tea in the house. It is close enough to the Moganshan shuttle stop to walk.

comments.quote: 房間衞生間和陽台有頭髮沒清掃乾淨，衞生間沒有窗建議加個換氣扇，馬桶圈有點開裂坐着不舒服。
comments.author: Anonymous User
